name: Fisch Wiki Evidence Tools
note: This is the definition for the LOCAL service included in this project, not a verified public Fischipedia API. AI tools must be connected to these HTTP routes by the host/orchestrator.

tools.name: wiki_status
tools.purpose: Check full index coverage and freshness before any claim of completeness

tools.name: wiki_search
tools.purpose: Search indexed content fragments, not a guarantee of a complete list

tools.name: wiki_page
tools.purpose: Read original page content and extracted tables with provenance

tools.name: wiki_table
tools.purpose: Read one table on a wiki page without loading all other tables

tools.name: wiki_category
tools.purpose: Enumerate indexed articles in one category, paginating through total

tools.name: wiki_pages
tools.purpose: Enumerate all indexed-inventory titles and namespaces with pagination

tools.name: wiki_failed
tools.purpose: List pages that failed to download during last synchronization

mandatory_rules.sources: Only data from fischipedia.org, with real page links
